subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should `run.execution_phase` become a supported public `DiagnosticEventPayload` variant for external plugins, with diagnostic event kinds explicitly treated as additive and non-exhaustive?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but only maintainers can accept the permanent Plugin SDK compatibility policy and future stability obligation for the closed phase vocabulary.

options.title: Approve Public Event
options.body: Accept the additive union variant, documented non-exhaustive consumer pattern, and stable phase-name obligation, then rebase and land under normal gates.

options.title: Keep It Internal
options.body: Preserve the runner-to-diagnostics bridge for bundled diagnostics consumers without exporting the new event through the public Plugin SDK union.

options.title: Decline The Surface
options.body: Close the paired feature direction and keep external consumers on existing hooks and broader run/model diagnostic events.

recommendation.title: Approve Public Event
recommendation.body: Accept the additive union variant, documented non-exhaustive consumer pattern, and stable phase-name obligation, then rebase and land under normal gates.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged diagnostics work defines the current public/internal subscription boundary and Plugin SDK exposure model affected by this choice.
